title: Microsoft Viva: Organizational Data in Microsoft 365 for GCC-Moderate tenants
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap availability, upload prerequisites, licensing and governance controls are supported. Minor corrections should complete the control instructions and acknowledge conflicting Microsoft guidance about blank values in uploads.

claims.claim: Organizational Data in Microsoft 365 is available in GCC-Moderate.
claims.quote: Organizational Data in Microsoft 365 is now available in the GCC-Moderate (GCC-M) environment!

claims.claim: The roadmap says government customers get ingestion capabilities previously available only commercially.
claims.quote: government cloud customers can now leverage the same powerful data ingestion capabilities previously available only in commercial environments.

claims.claim: The roadmap status is Launched.
claims.quote: "status": "Launched", "statusKey": "launched"

claims.claim: The roadmap target is May CY2026.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "May CY2026"

claims.claim: The release phase is General Availability.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability"]

claims.claim: The roadmap modification timestamp is 2026-07-02T23:12:48.
The service imports employee data from HR systems into Microsoft 365 through the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: access Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service through the Microsoft 365 admin center to import organizational data and onboard Microsoft 365 and Viva apps.

claims.claim: Organizational data includes job title, manager relationships, location and custom attributes.
claims.quote: including attributes such as job title, department, manager relationships, organization structure, location, and other profile attributes.

claims.claim: The service supports CSV imports.
claims.quote: CSV Import | You upload a .csv file directly to Microsoft.

claims.claim: The service documents a Workday connector.
claims.quote: Workday Connector | Microsoft pulls data directly from Workday's Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP) APIs using Workday credentials that you provide.

claims.claim: The service documents a SAP SuccessFactors connector.
claims.quote: SAP SuccessFactors Connector | Microsoft pulls data directly from SAP SuccessFactors's public APIs using SAP SuccessFactors credentials that you provide.

claims.claim: The service documents an Azure Blob Storage connector.
claims.quote: Azure Blob Storage Connector | Microsoft pulls your .csv file from Azure Blob using a Blob container URL you provide.

claims.claim: Microsoft marks the API-based connector as public preview.
claims.quote: API-based Connector (Public Preview) | You send a .csv file from any HRIS source to the Microsoft API.

claims.claim: The service distributes data to Microsoft 365 Profile, Copilot and Viva apps.
claims.quote: it can be securely distributed to supported applications such as Microsoft 365 Profile, Microsoft Copilot, People Skills, Insights, Viva Glint, and other connected apps.

claims.claim: Public attributes are automatically available to Profile and eligible downstream apps.
claims.quote: These public organizational attributes are automatically available to Microsoft 365 Profile and the apps built on top of it, including profile cards, Org Explorer, Microsoft Search, Copilot, agents, and the downstream applications onboarded to Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service.

claims.claim: Administrators choose which apps receive custom attributes.
claims.quote: For supported destinations such as Insights and Viva Glint, you can choose which custom and application-specific attributes are distributed to each app.

claims.where: controls[1].note; What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Custom attributes default to Staging, which releases data to no users until configured, subject to self-access.
claims.quote: Staging is the default policy for custom attributes. The default settings for Staging don't release the data to any users. Admin configuration is required to make custom attributes available to users.

claims.claim: Users have access to data describing themselves in addition to policy-granted access.
claims.quote: In Microsoft 365, users have access to data that describes themselves, such as performance ratings. This access is available in addition to any permissions granted by a policy.

claims.claim: Only Global Administrators and Organizational Data Source Administrators can upload data.
claims.quote: Only Global Administrators and Organizational Data Source Administrators can upload data.

claims.claim: A Global Administrator completes provisioning in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Global Administrator | | Complete provisioning. In the Microsoft 365 admin center, go to Setup > Migration and imports > Organizational Data in Microsoft 365 and complete the provisioning process.

claims.claim: Organizational Data Service guidance says a Global Administrator assigns the source administrator role.
claims.quote: The Organizational Data Source Administrator role is assigned by a Global Administrator.

claims.claim: The Entra assignment instructions require at least Privileged Role Administrator.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Entra admin center as at least a Privileged Role Administrator.

claims.claim: Assign the role through Microsoft Entra admin center > Identity > Roles & admins > role > Add assignments.
claims.quote: Browse to Identity > Roles & admins. ... Select a role name to open the role. ... Select Add assignments and then select the users, groups, or agent identities you want to assign to this role.

claims.claim: POST /v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments assigns the source administrator role.
claims.quote:
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments
{
 "@odata.type": "#microsoft.graph.unifiedRoleAssignment",
 "principalId": "<Object ID of user or group>",
 "roleDefinitionId": "<ID of role definition>",
 "directoryScopeId": "/"
}
claims.fix: Append to controls[0].note: 'The request body uses roleDefinitionId for the Organizational Data Source Administrator role, principalId for the assignee, and directoryScopeId set to / for tenant scope.'

claims.claim: Tenant access policies determine who can see organizational attributes and for which employee population.
claims.quote: Access policies define who can access which organizational data attributes, for what population.

claims.claim: Global Administrators or Organizational Data Source Administrators manage access policies.
claims.quote: The Microsoft 365 Global Administrator or the Organizational Data Source Administrator create and manage these policies centrally in Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service.

claims.claim: The printed Settings > Setup > Migration and Imports route reaches Edit access policies.
claims.quote: Under the tools to migrate or import data table, select Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service. ... select Settings. ... Under the Organization-wide access policy section, select Edit access policies.
claims.fix: Keep the documented route and append to controls[1].note: 'To apply a policy, under Access policies for custom attributes select the attributes, choose Select access policy, and pick the policy to apply.' The cited page documents these remaining steps.

Opened set-access-policies and Graph profile precedence; no policy-setting API found.

claims.claim: Reserved attribute access policies are fixed and cannot be edited.
claims.quote: Reserved attribute access policies are preset and aren't editable.

claims.quote: The organizational data you upload can be used by Viva, Microsoft 365 services, and non-Microsoft services that have access through the Microsoft Graph API.

claims.claim: The Workday connector uses credentials supplied for Workday.
claims.quote: Microsoft pulls data directly from Workday's Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP) APIs using Workday credentials that you provide.

claims.claim: The SAP SuccessFactors connector uses credentials supplied for SAP SuccessFactors.

claims.claim: Blank or empty upload values preserve previously uploaded values.
claims.quote: If you include an attribute but leave the value blank or empty, the previously uploaded value will be used and the existing value won't be updated. New uploads merge with previous data and don't overwrite that data.
claims.fix: Append: 'The Office 365 Data Subject Requests page gives conflicting guidance, saying an empty attribute value deletes the current value; confirm deletion behaviour before relying on blanks.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/compliance/regulatory/gdpr-dsr-office365#organizational-data-in-microsoft-365.

claims.claim: The import instructions require explicit deletion values instead of ordinary blank cells.
claims.quote: To delete string values for a user, enter three single quotes (''') in Excel or two ('') in the .csv file. ... To delete integer values for a user, set the value of the attribute to -1.

claims.where: controls[2].governs; Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Prioritizing organizational data over Entra changes overlapping profile values displayed to users.
claims.quote: If you assign data precedence to organizational data, when an experience like Profile cards in Microsoft 365 queries the Microsoft 365 User Profile to get the jobTitle property for that end user, "Senior Software Engineer" is returned instead of "Software Engineer."

claims.claim: Microsoft Entra data has default precedence over Organizational Data Service.
claims.quote: Microsoft Entra ID. ... Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service. ... By default, Entra ID is the prioritized source of profile data in an organization.

claims.claim: The service's data precedence UI is documented for Global Administrators.
claims.quote: How to assign data precedence ... Applies to: Microsoft 365 Global Administrator

claims.claim: Settings > Viva > Data management > Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service > Settings > Data prioritization > Edit data prioritization reaches the precedence screen.
claims.quote: On the left, select Settings. Under Data prioritization, select Edit data prioritization. ... Use the arrows in the table to re-order the list of connectors based on how you'd like to prioritize the data.
claims.fix: Keep the path: its initial Settings > Viva > Data management > Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service steps are documented in the already-cited get-started page. Append to controls[2].note: 'On this screen, use the arrows in the table to re-order the connectors.'
